evals.name: connect-claude-code-and-codex
evals.prompt: 我在 Windows 上同时用 Claude Code 和 Codex，想让它们都走本机的 aproxy（已经在 12345 端口跑着，我自己现在也在用它）。帮我把两边需要改的配置写出来，存成文件放到输出目录，并告诉我怎么确认它们真的走了 aproxy。
evals.expected_output: Claude Code: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:12345 plus CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS set to a large value (e.g. 86400000), via env or ~/.claude/settings.json env block. Codex: a model provider in ~/.codex/config.toml with base_url http://127.0.0.1:12345/v1, wire_api = "responses", stream_idle_timeout_ms large, selected via model_provider. Verification through aproxy logs / status. Does not stop or restart the running instance.

evals.name: compact-hangs-count-tokens-404
evals.prompt: Claude Code 接的是一个中转站 API，经过 aproxy 之后每次 /compact 都卡住一直转圈。aproxy 日志里看到 POST /v1/messages/count_tokens?beta=true 一直返回 404 然后在重试。我的配置文件是 ~/.aproxy/config.toml，这个实例的别名是 relay。应该怎么改？把要改的配置片段和要执行的命令写到输出目录的 answer.md 里。
evals.expected_output: Add bounded_retry_paths to the instance config with a pattern that matches the path including the query string (e.g. '/v1/messages/count_tokens(\?.*)?' or an explicit '\?beta=true' variant), explain that the match covers path+query and is anchored, then apply with aproxy restart relay. Does not suggest forward_only or disabling retries globally.

evals.name: add-second-instance-with-alias
evals.prompt: 我想再开一个 aproxy 实例：监听 12346，上游是 https://api.example.com，用单独的配置文件，别名叫 work，以后用 aproxy stop work 就能停它。现有的 12345 实例正在被我用着，别动它。把完整步骤（配置文件内容 + 要执行的命令）写到输出目录的 answer.md 里。
evals.expected_output: A separate config file (e.g. ~/.aproxy/work.toml) with base_url = "https://api.example.com" and listen_addr = "127.0.0.1:12346"; aproxy alias add work <path>; aproxy start work; verify with aproxy status; never stop all / restart / touch 12345.
